opening.argument: The presentation promotes Forsage as a business opportunity, calling it “the best ..opportunity,” welcomes viewers into ForSageFamily, and directs them to a meeting where leaders will explain the plan. Viewers are told, “If you understand the plan,” they can begin planning their own, while the speaker refers to “the time to earn our money” and points to “the links given in the video.” These are not general educational remarks; they invite participation in the named program and recruitment into its plan, whose paid-slot and recruitment-dependent compensation structure is described separately in an SEC complaint. At the same time, the short invitation does not explain that structure or show a completed payment.
